title: What a Client Holds Elsewhere in the Dining Programme, and What it Changes at the Micro Market
content:
What a client holds elsewhere in the dining programme changes what an Unattended Micro Market Program market settles and where its subsidy may be spent.

## Where a cafe contract stands at the same site

Where the same client holds an active workplace cafe management contract at the site the market stands in, the two subsidy pools are read as one for the employee daily ceiling.

The clause reading "the ceiling printed against the cafe service model governs both outlets together rather than each separately" is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which the ceiling is applied to a discount booked to the agreement after the trip.

Where there is no cafe contract at the site, the market's own daily ceiling printed against its format governs, and nothing is pooled.

Where the cafe contract at the site closes, the market's own daily ceiling takes over from the next settlement period, and drawdowns already posted are not reopened.

## Where a vending programme stands at the same site

Where the same client holds an active vending programme at the site, the equipment lease on the market is invoiced in full, and the commission the vending programme pays back is settled on its own statement; the two are never netted against each other.

## Markets and cafes at one site

A micro market and a full service cafe at the same site are not mutually exclusive, and clients commonly hold both; but a market may not be installed at a site where the cafe contract's service model already includes an unattended grab and go wall, since that wall is the market.

superseded_clauses: the ceiling printed against the cafe service model governs both outlets together rather than each separately
